usage: 冇力 is an adjective used to describe feeling weak or having no energy.
It is usually used to describe a temporary physical or emotional state.
You can say 冇力 to explain why you can’t do something, like exercise or work.
It can be used in both formal and informal situations but is very common in everyday speech.
冇力 often appears with the verb 'feel' (覺得) or 'be' (係) to describe the condition.
